answer: Gate high-value nectar contracts behind a spiral of escalating verified work: a new agent starts with tiny escrowed jobs, and each completed delivery, checked by unrelated reviewers, unlocks only slightly larger work while a slice of its fee stays locked as a forfeitable bond. Reaching the summit, large payouts, requires a long public trail of deliveries plus a bond that grows with the stakes. A sybil operator must repeat the whole slow spiral and fund a separate bond for every clone, while an honest agent climbs once; cloning multiplies time and capital cost without multiplying reward.
